ظِلٌّ قَالِصٌ Shade [contracting, or shrinking, from one: (see 1:) or] decreasing: (S, TA:) [or going away.] شَفَةٌ قَالِصَةٌ A contracting lip: (S:) and رَجُلٌ قَالِصُ الشَّفَةِ a man having a contracting lip. (Msb.) ثَوْبٌ قَالِصٌ A garment contracted and short: (Sh, TA:) and ↓ قميص مُقَلِّصٌ a short shirt: (A:) or a shirt contracted, or raised, or tucked up: and ↓ دِرْعٌ مُقَلِّصَةٌ [a coat of mail contracted]: most frequently meaning upwards. (TA.) ―
-b2- مَآءٌ قَالِصٌ and ↓ قَلِيصٌ and ↓ قَلَّاصٌ Water collecting and becoming abundant in a well: (TA:) or rising, or high, (S, M, K,) in a well: (S:) the pl. of قَلِيصٌ is قُلُصٌ. (TA.) See also 1.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
